# Harbor telemetry

Shared concepts for the Callowmere harbor work: the archived
[[entity-Project-Kestrel]] bathymetry survey informs buoy placement for
[[entity-Project-Lighthouse-v2]]; both report to [[entity-Marina]].
Depth alerting should be tide-aware (see the May 2026 review).
